A revision to the national standards and statutory guidance for advocacy is central to delivering our plans to improve advocacy provision.

High quality advocacy provision ensures that the views, wishes and needs of children and young people are heard by the professionals making decisions about their lives. It supports children and young people to navigate the system, especially in times of transition.
